This year marks 15 years of the F1Chinese Grand Prix at SAIC INTERNATIONAL CIRCUIT. On behalf of everyone at Shanghai Juss Sports Development (Group) Co., Ltd.; the host of the Chinese Grand Prix, I would like to extend my warmest and sincerest welcome to all the media from around the world. After 14 years' of great efforts, the Chinese Grand Prix has developed and grown in stature. Its participation has increased and its value has been enhanced. The Chinese Grand Prix has been consistently and successfully staged in Shanghai, which positions itself within the sports world, the power and spirit of the city of Shanghai. We are honoured to have such a large number of fans and media recognition. The result has been that the Chinese Grand Prix has established an important status in formula one family. Thank you very much for your efforts to promote F1 in China. We hereby ensure that the entire staff of Chinese Grand Prix will do their best to create a more convenient and comfortable working environment. Furthermore, our staff is committed to provide meticulous and thoughtful services for the duration for the Chinese Grand Prix.Sincerely wish you enjoy your stay in Shanghai！Vice President of Shanghai Jiushi (Group) Co., Ltd.
